# HealthHub by Al-Futtaim

> HealthHub is a multi-specialty healthcare network across Dubai offering clinics, telehealth services, and specialized treatments through the Al-Futtaim group.

HealthHub operates a network of medical centers and specialty clinics across multiple Dubai locations including Jumeirah Village Circle, Arabian Center, Barsha Heights, Festival City, and others. The platform provides appointment booking, telehealth consultations, and a comprehensive directory of medical specialties and healthcare providers.

## Core Services & Platforms

- [HealthHub Homepage](https://www.healthhubalfuttaim.com): Main landing page showcasing multi-clinic healthcare network across Dubai locations
- [Clinic Directory](https://www.healthhubalfuttaim.com/clinics): Main clinic directory and location finder for HealthHub multi-specialty centers
- [Medical Specialties](https://www.healthhubalfuttaim.com/specialties): Directory of medical specialties and healthcare services offered by HealthHub clinics
- [Telehealth Online Consultation](https://www.healthhubalfuttaim.com/telehealth): Virtual doctor appointment and online consultation service platform

## Specialty Services

- [Hair Transplant Services](https://www.healthhubalfuttaim.com/hair-transplant-book-now): Hair transplant service with FUE and Direct Implantation booking options
- [Day Surgery Center](https://www.healthhubalfuttaim.com/clinics/day-surgery-center): Day Surgery Center at Festival City with endoscopy and specialty surgical services

## Clinic Locations - Central & West Dubai

- [HealthHub Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC)](https://www.healthhubalfuttaim.com/clinics/healthhub-jvc-jumeirah-village-circle): Multi-specialty clinic at Jumeirah Village Circle with Dr. Ankit Mudgal
- [HealthHub Arabian Center](https://www.healthhubalfuttaim.com/clinics/healthhub-arabian-center): Multi-specialty clinic at Arabian Center with Dr. Alanoud Shatat and pharmacy services
- [HealthHub Festival Plaza](https://www.healthhubalfuttaim.com/clinics/healthhub-festival-plaza): Multi-specialty medical center at Festival Plaza, Jebel Ali
- [HealthHub Barsha Heights](https://www.healthhubalfuttaim.com/clinics/healthhub-barsha-heights): Multi-specialty clinic at Barsha Heights with Dr. Ali Raza and Dr. Aneesh
- [HealthHub Discovery Gardens](https://www.healthhubalfuttaim.com/clinics/discovery-gardens): Multi-specialty clinic at Discovery Gardens with Dr. Abhay Pande

## Clinic Locations - East & North Dubai

- [HealthHub Silicon Oasis](https://www.healthhubalfuttaim.com/clinics/silicon-oasis): Multi-specialty clinic at Silicon Oasis with specialist doctor directory
- [HealthHub International City](https://www.healthhubalfuttaim.com/clinics/international-city): Multi-specialty clinic at International City with multiple specialist doctors
- [HealthHub Al Qusais](https://www.healthhubalfuttaim.com/clinics/healthhub-al-qusais): Multi-specialty clinic at Al Qusais with multiple specialist doctors and pharmacy
- [HealthHub Al Nahda](https://www.healthhubalfuttaim.com/clinics/healthhub-al-nahda): Multi-specialty clinic at Al Nahda with Dr. Alvin Clavert Casono
- [HealthHub Al Warqa](https://www.healthhubalfuttaim.com/clinics/healthhub-al-warqa): Multi-specialty clinic at Al Warqa with pharmacy services
